description: PRD #1258: the words and formats both clients use for a deck's host (CLAUDE.md rule 22). Read by the TUI's `dashboard_host_metrics_008_*` (tests/render_host_metrics_copy.rs), which renders the host overlay, and by the desktop's HostMetricsPanel.copy.test.tsx, which renders the deck card's host panel, so a word or format changed on one side fails the other. Each sample is the daemon's wire shape (snake_case); `rows` is every label/value row the client draws for it, in order. `notAvailable` is the text for a deck that does not report host metrics.
title: Host of this deck
subtitle: The machine this deck's daemon runs on
notAvailable: Host metrics are not available from this deck.
Its daemon is an older version, or runs on Windows.
